title: Decorator — wrap with logging (Javascript)
description: A decorator wraps a function to add behavior (logging, timing, auth) without changing it. Higher-order functions are JavaScript's native decorator.
how_it_works: The wrapper calls through, then logs the result — the original stays untouched.
complexity: O(wrapped). Tuning: profile before optimizing; the notes above name the usual bottleneck to measure first.

test_cases.note: Determinism check: re-running the snippet reproduces the identical output.

pitfalls: Wrappers must forward arguments and `this` faithfully.
